deploy.preDeployCommand: node dist/database/migrate.js && node --input-type=module -e 'import {createDatabase} from "./dist/database/client.js"; import {env,getNativeLiveAttachmentStorageConfig} from "./dist/config/env.js"; import {S3PresignedAttachmentObjectStore} from "./dist/domains/bridge/native-live-attachment-storage.js"; import {DrizzleNativeLiveInlineAttachmentMigrationRepository,migrateNativeLiveAttachmentInlineContentUntilIdle} from "./dist/domains/bridge/native-live-attachment-migration.js"; const config=getNativeLiveAttachmentStorageConfig(env); if(!config) throw new Error("Bucket configuration is required"); const resource=createDatabase(env.DATABASE_URL); try { const repository=new DrizzleNativeLiveInlineAttachmentMigrationRepository(resource.db); const store=new S3PresignedAttachmentObjectStore(config); const result=await migrateNativeLiveAttachmentInlineContentUntilIdle(repository,store,{batchSize:8,maxBatches:128}); console.log("NATIVE_LIVE_ATTACHMENT_MIGRATION_RESULT="+JSON.stringify(result)); if(result.failed>0) throw new Error("Native Live attachment migration reported failures"); } finally { await resource.close(); }'
